claim: In E1M2 what rides on the outside of the moving car (s10, type 616) stands in its host sector s34, which is a 614 with the same motion (its own markers 303/304, the same displacement, channel 111 and time 120) whose outline's walls are left unflagged: the sprites that ride (its wheels) carry cstat 8192, its outline stays. Holes inside the host may still move with it.
evidence: E1M2 s34: type 614, markers 303/304, rx 111, busy 120, alongside the car s10 (type 616, markers 300/301, rx 111, busy 120; both pairs 24,064 apart along y); wheel sprites 66, 67, 70, 71 (tile 847) carry bit 8192; its 23-wall outline has no wall flagged 16384, but its hole 386-389 is flagged throughout and walls 390, 396 and 397 of another hole are flagged (knowledge/blood/findings/probes/consolidation_e1m2_rider_host.py, 2026-11-26); studied in knowledge/blood/studies/moving-bodies
